limitations: Source-bounded census, not every drug ever developed or every medicine worldwide.
Maximum development phase is historical, not proof of current authorization, development activity, jurisdiction, formulation, pediatric safety, or efficacy.
Withdrawn flag does not mean withdrawal everywhere; no false-to-currently-marketed inference.
DrugCentral 2023 SDF / 2021 SMILES and interactions have different dates; approval CSV content version is unreported, HTTP metadata retained.
Status-unverified DrugCentral entries outside clinical/withdrawal/approval filters are retained separately, not promoted to medicines by chemical identity alone.
Parent-group counts retain molecular/formulation heterogeneity and unresolved cross-source duplicates; not a definitive count of distinct active ingredients.
Target annotations, assay records and interactions do not establish pharmacological benefit or mutant rescue.
Missing annotations are UNKNOWN, not evidence of inefficacy.
No whole-transcriptome perturbation, all-drug docking, clinical intervention, or experiment performed.
source_scope: ChEMBL max_phase>=1 OR withdrawn_flag; union DrugCentral FDA/EMA/PMDA approval lists
